# Miransas

> Miransas (`https://miransas.com`) is an independent voice AI research lab and software engineering studio founded by Sardor Azimov. Miransas builds Miralas (`https://miralas.io`), researches native Uzbek and multilingual speech synthesis, designs permission-based voice cloning workflows, and engineers low-latency Rust and Python voice infrastructure over gRPC.

## Core Platform & Research

- **Miralas (`https://miralas.io`)**: Flagship voice AI platform in development for creators, streamers, and developers. Combines multilingual text-to-speech, permission-based voice cloning, and conversational voice infrastructure.
- **Multilingual Speech Baseline**: Built on the approved `t3_mtl23ls_v2.safetensors` Chatterbox Multilingual checkpoint covering 23 languages with pinned artifact verification before loading.
- **Uzbek Speech Research (In Development)**: Dedicated speech research initiative building toward native Uzbek text-to-speech and speech-to-speech capabilities outside the 23-language upstream baseline.
- **Permission-Based Voice Cloning**: Voice identity architecture designed with explicit voice owner consent and responsible use from the ground up.
- **Voice Agent (In Development)**: Self-hosted conversational voice infrastructure connecting spoken requests, session state, and structured workflows (such as orders and appointments).
- **Voice Infrastructure Architecture**: Rust API gateway handling authorization and routing connected over gRPC to a Python voice worker producing 24 kHz mono PCM16 audio output.

## Additional Engineering Projects

- **Binboi (`https://binboi.com`)**: Live in production. Self-hosted ngrok alternative built with a Go backend and Next.js frontend.
- **VS Code Uzbek Language Pack**: Published on the Visual Studio Code Marketplace. Native Uzbek localization of the VS Code interface.
- **Miransas Pulse**: Native macOS system monitor built in C, Objective-C, and Cocoa.
- **Miransas Chess**: Chess engine written in Rust (in development).
- **CourierX**: Self-hosted email API written in Rust (paused to focus on Miralas).
